## Learning Goals {background-color="#1B4332"}

*Objectifs d'apprentissage*

By the end of today, you can:

- Understand the senses of insects
- Define "infochemical" and classify infochemical types (pheromone
  subtypes; allomone, kairomone, synomone) from concrete examples 
- Explain sensory evolution<br>
  -Provide evolutionary explanations for why certain species have highly developed senses<br>
  -Discuss trade-offs of sensory specialization
- Frame chemical communication as an information-transfer process
